conclusion: The 60-additional-game continuation completed, but neither network-only nor search evaluation showed any new Japanese Chinese territorial acquisitions. Mixed loss/wealth changes do not establish improved offensive play.

task.reward: terminal wealth gap; zero intermediate reward; gamma=1
task.short_task_limit: Horizon variants are curriculum tasks, not July1941 campaign results.

contract.territorial_scope: authoritative KMT Chinese Home Country, Japan possession only

limitations: Network-only and search changes are reported separately against unchanged fixed opponents.
Japan possession is the primary metric; Dadao Chinese possessions are supplementary and never count as Japan.
Acquisitions include influence/alignment and recaptures; only recorded action kind is claimed as causal evidence.
Unit removals include combat, surrender and forced removal, not combat casualties alone.
Matching seeds do not imply identical later dice events once policies choose different actions.
Eight seeds and one continued initialization do not establish general playing strength.
No new Japanese acquisition events occurred in these 32 held-out games; zero ending gains did not hide temporary acquisitions.
Observed loss and wealth changes are mixed and do not establish offensive improvement or full eleven-round competence.
75 completion executions include 15 discarded and recomputed outcomes; only 60 additional completions are retained.
Time buckets and summed progress timers are incomplete for killed/overwritten invocation reports; inclusive supervisor charged time is reported separately.
The 17 cycle intervals include repeated work; they are physical measurements, not 17 unique batches.
Live menus/allocation history exceeded the synthetic preflight envelope; memory scaling remains unresolved.
Resource peaks are sampled, not a kernel memory cap. The sampled 26.008 GB peak is below the 30 GB user allowance.
Final recovery artifact was stream-hashed and separately restored under a 24 GB guard; that verification is outside training throughput.

provenance.operational_migration_scope: monitor diagnostics and bounded setuid-ps EPERM/ESRCH exit-race retries only; tests and launch docs

resources.metric: sum of per-process max(RSS, macOS physical footprint including compressed pages)
resources.resource_scope: Pipeline, independent guardian, sleep prevention, supervisor and full child process tree; sum of per-process max(RSS, macOS physical footprint including compressed pages); sampled with 1 GB safety margin

four_game_physical_cycle_intervals.scope: Update-to-update intervals within the same child invocation, excluding each first partial batch; include collection, learning, saves and reporting plus repeated work. They are not 17 unique batches.

limitations: This compares only the captured logged overlap; future appended records are not part of this snapshot.
It does not inspect unlogged MCTS internals, hidden intermediate states or optimizer tensors.
A state-key match is not a substitute for the separate continuation checkpoint proof or model-export validation.
replayed_logged_overlap.scope: All emitted fields other than elapsed time, including exact action order/parameters and before/after planning keys; recorded clocks, terminal flags, returns and counters.
